{{Quote|My sister! Where could she be? You! Will you help me? She has been kidnapped by pirates. Please help me, I don't have enough money to pay their ransom. Will you save her for me?|Hanna S'kiyah, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HS" />}}
'''Hanna S'kiyah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], her sister was kidnapped by the [[Naboo pirates]] and kept prisoner for ransom. Although the pirates used to capture wealthy [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]], Hanna S'kiyah did not have enough money to pay a ransom.<ref name="SWG:HS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she met a spacer near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and begged the spacer to rescue her sister. Hanna S'kiyah provided the location of the [[Pirate Bunker]] and hoped the spacer could be successful.<ref name="SWG:HS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hanna S'kiyah was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hanna S'kiyah was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
